prompt: Create an original 150 second melodic breakbeat electronica instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: breakbeat drums, rounded bass, shimmering synth. Style: syncopated chopped drum rhythm under an evolving melody. Tempo approximately 128 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: An energetic and uplifting progressive house track featuring a driving electronic beat, deep synth bass, evolving arpeggiated melodies, and atmospheric pads. The track builds consistently with a positive and futuristic vibe.
